summary: This bill allows civilian service in a temporary position after December 31, 1988, to be creditable service under the Federal Employees Retirement System, enabling more federal employees to count their temporary work towards retirement benefits.

scores.thoughts: This bill expands the definition of creditable service for federal employees under the Federal Employees Retirement System, allowing temporary service after 1988 to count towards retirement. This change would likely increase future government outlays for retirement benefits, thus increasing government spending.
